blocks.text: Repo ya instagram-agent-skill ilikuja na skills 13 nzuri za kuandika Instagram, lakini templates/voice.md ilikuwa tupu. blocks.label: Ugonjwa
blocks.text: Prompt ilielezea MADA ('make a video about my POS app') badala ya KITU HALISI (repo, mstari wa code, risiti, namba). Modeli ikajaza pengo na laptop, globe na purple-blue gradient. Pia iliombwa KUCHORA CODE - jambo ambalo modeli ya video haiwezi.

items: Sauti haikuwa imeandikwa popote -> tumejaza voice.md mbili.
Hakuna brand tokens -> tumetumia hex/fonti/mwendo kutoka motion-lab yako mwenyewe.
Hakuna shot list wala negative prompt -> tumetengeneza beats 40 zenye sekunde.
Hakuna QA gate -> check.py na zana 5 za repo zimeendeshwa kweli.

blocks.text: Uamuzi wa mmiliki: strategy ni Kiswahili, lakini English ni lugha kubwa na haiwezi kupuuzwa, hasa kwenye captions. Hii si maelewano - ndiyo mfumo sahihi: matoleo mawili, si tafsiri.

blocks.label: Uaminifu
blocks.text: Instagram aliandika 2021 kwamba keyword search results ilianza na Kiingereza na lugha nyingine zitaongezwa baadaye. Sijapata tamko rasmi la 2026 la lugha zote. Kwa hiyo bio ya Kiswahili kamili inaweza kuwa dhaifu kidogo kwenye IG Search - fidia ni maneno ya Kiingereza kwenye caption, alt text, hashtag na location tag. Hatujadai 'Kiswahili SEO guaranteed'.
Brand ni Altraware Tech. Username @altrawaretechnology haibadilishwi. Website bado ni subdomain altra.tanzaniareach.com - hakuna domain yetu, 'tunajitafuta'. Hiyo haijafichwa wala haijaigizwa.

blocks.label: Subdomain si aibu
blocks.text: Usiiite 'official website', usibuni altra.tech au .co.tz ya kufikirika. Ukishapata domain, badilisha LINK MOJA tu kwenye bio; name, bio, captions, pinned na highlights zinabaki. Vile vile Gmail ni sawa kwa hatua hii - ukishapata domain, tengeneza email ya domain.

blocks.label: Hakuna setting ya siri
blocks.text: Hakuna toggle inayokupa reach. Vile vya 'weka settings hizi uonekane' ni: public + professional + indexing ON + keywords mahali sahihi + Account Status safi. Vingine ni kazi ya content na muda.

items: Keyword MOJA kwenye mstari wa kwanza wa caption, ndani ya herufi 125 zinazoonekana kabla ya '... more'.
Keywords na hashtag kwenye CAPTION, si kwenye comments - ndivyo Instagram mwenyewe anavyosema.
Hashtag 3-5 maalum, zinazozungushwa. Cap rasmi = 5 tangu 18 Desemba 2025.
Alt text kila picha. Ni accessibility; Instagram HAIJATHIBITISHA kuwa ni ranking signal - tunaiandika kwa sababu ni sahihi, si kama hack.
Reel 9:16, chini ya dakika 3, first 3 seconds inashika; keyword inasemeka na inaonekana kwenye captions zilizoburniwa.
Location tag Dar es Salaam / Kariakoo inapohusika.
Ask MOJA tu. Hakuna URL wala emoji bullets kwenye caption.
Original content tu: 10+ reposts za wengine ndani ya siku 30 = hutoki kwenye recommendations.

blocks.label: Vipimo vya kweli
blocks.text: Watch time, DM shares (sends) na saves ndizo zinazobeba reach; likes ni za pili. Pendekezo: 3-5 post kwa wiki, niche moja. Haya ni heuristics za industry, si ahadi ya viral - retention graph yako baada ya post 30 ndiyo hakimu.

head: Nguzo
Inaonyesha nini
Mfano
rows: Prompt moja, video ya kawaida -> tabaka 7

items: Wiki 1: profile + voice + carousel 01 (POS) + 03 (BEI) + Reel ya kwanza.
Wiki 2-4: 4-5 post kwa wiki, 1-3 Stories kwa siku, keyword moja kwa kila post.
CTA / keyword: POS, BEI, MKATABA, AUDIT, CODE, PROMPT, LUGHA. Ask moja tu.
DM: wao wanaanza, wewe unajibu. Hakuna bulk DM, hakuna auto-DM.
Baada ya post 10-30: log.md -> /ig-audit na /ig-viral zenye evidence yako.

blocks.text: Vyanzo vya ukweli ni faili za JSON. PNG, MP4, PDF, Google Doc na tovuti ya Vercel ni OUTPUT zinazoweza kuzalishwa upya - usihariri output moja kwa moja.

blocks.label: Hatujadai
blocks.text: Hakuna majina ya wateja, NIDA/IMEI halisi, asilimia za matokeo, wala ushuhuda wa kubuni. 99.98% uptime, 24ms, 0.8s checkout, 10x, 'Neema' na '100% code ownership' ni SELF-CLAIMED au yanagongana na clause 3 ya mkataba - hayajatumika kama proof. Migongano 5 bado inahitaji uamuzi wako (01-presence-audit.md §5).

Akaunti ya zamani @mwijay.davie (~12K, wengi bots, ilibanwa baada ya automation na token ya Meta API iliyovuja) ni taarifa ya mmiliki, SI iliyothibitishwa hadharani. Iko kwenye 01-presence-audit.md §8 kama risk context tu - haijaingia kwenye caption, bio, prompt wala PNG yoyote.

items: Password mpya unique + 2FA kwa authenticator app + recovery codes offline.
Email ya account iwe na 2FA yake yenyewe kwanza.
Accounts Center -> Where You're Logged In -> logout wasiotambulika.
Accounts Center -> Apps and Websites -> Remove kila app usiyoitumia leo.
Meta App Dashboard -> reset App Secret, Require App Secret ON, revoke tokens; GitHub secret scanning kwenye repo zote. Rotate KWANZA, kisha safisha history.
Hakuna app ya 'free followers', hakuna auto-follow/auto-like/mass DM, hakuna password au 2FA code kwa mtu yeyote.
Recovery ikihitajika: instagram.com/hacked na Meta Account Recovery Hub tu. Hakuna support email wala hotline; DM za 'Meta Support' ni scam.
